info.title: EcoLens API
info.description: Finds and tests long-term trends in NASA Earth science variables.

message.title: Message
message.description: Safe to show to the user, in English

understood.title: Understood
understood.description: False when no place or topic could be extracted

interpretation.title: Interpretation
interpretation.description: One sentence restating the question as an investigation

location.description: From the geocoder, never from the LLM

variable_ids.title: Variable Ids
variable_ids.description: Subset of the catalog, never invented ids

AskResult.title: AskResult
AskResult.description: Free-text question parsed by the AI assistant. Contains no numbers and no verdicts.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Service the data is fetched from, e.g. 'NASA POWER'

DataSource.title: DataSource
DataSource.description: Where a variable comes from. `product` is the originating NASA product.

narrative.title: Narrative
narrative.description: Short steps of the investigation, in order

DemoCase.title: DemoCase
DemoCase.description: A saved investigation the user can replay without waiting for live data.

emerged_year.title: Emerged Year
emerged_year.description: First end-year from which the trend stays significant to the end of the record

years_needed.title: Years Needed
years_needed.description: Weatherhead et al. (1998) record length needed to detect the current slope

additional_years.title: Additional Years
additional_years.description: years_needed minus years available, rounded up; 0 when already emerged

noise_std.title: Noise Std
noise_std.description: Standard deviation of the detrended residuals

Emergence.title: Emergence
Emergence.description: Block C. When did the trend become significant, or how long until it could?

FitPoint.title: FitPoint
FitPoint.description: OLS trend line with its 95% confidence band for the mean.

assistant_available.title: Assistant Available
assistant_available.description: False when no Gemini key is configured

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: 1 = strongest trend; null when status is 'no_data'

slope_per_decade.title: Slope Per Decade
slope_per_decade.description: Sen's slope, in the variable's unit

standardized_slope.title: Standardized Slope
standardized_slope.description: Sen's slope divided by the series standard deviation (sigma per decade)

sparkline.title: Sparkline
sparkline.description: Annual values, one per year of the period

themes.title: Themes
themes.description: Restrict to these themes; omit for the whole catalog

variable_ids.title: Variable Ids
variable_ids.description: Restrict to these variables; wins over `themes`

p_value_hamed_rao.title: P Value Hamed Rao
p_value_hamed_rao.description: Mann-Kendall p-value with the Hamed and Rao (1998) variance correction for autocorrelation; null when it cannot be computed

ci95_low.title: Ci95 Low
ci95_low.description: Lower bound of the 95% CI of the slope, per decade

intercept.title: Intercept
intercept.description: Fitted value at the first year of the period

OppositeTwin.title: OppositeTwin
OppositeTwin.description: Two significant cells of the same map trending in opposite directions.

blurb.title: Blurb
blurb.description: One sentence on why this place is worth investigating

RunningPoint.title: RunningPoint
RunningPoint.description: Trend from the first year up to `end_year` (expanding window).

value.title: Value
value.description: Annual or seasonal mean; null when missing

question.title: Question
question.description: Guided-question wording, e.g. 'Is it getting hotter?'

slope_per_decade.title: Slope Per Decade
slope_per_decade.description: Sen's slope; null when the cell has no data

TrendMapResult.title: TrendMapResult
TrendMapResult.description: Block B. Slope per grid cell over a box of up to 10 x 10 degrees.

max_abs_slope.title: Max Abs Slope
max_abs_slope.description: Use as the symmetric limit of the colour scale

methods_agree.title: Methods Agree
methods_agree.description: OLS and Mann-Kendall reach the same conclusion

total_change.title: Total Change
total_change.description: OLS slope times the length of the period, in `unit`

percent_change.title: Percent Change
percent_change.description: total_change relative to the period mean; null when the mean is near zero

autocorrelation_corrected.title: Autocorrelation Corrected
autocorrelation_corrected.description: True when the verdict used the Hamed-Rao p-value because |lag-1 autocorrelation| > 0.3

first_year.title: First Year
first_year.description: First year with data for this variable

witness_group.title: Witness Group
witness_group.description: Variables sharing a group measure the same quantity from independent sources

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: One short sentence, e.g. 'Case closed: it is getting warmer.'

Verdict.title: Verdict
Verdict.description: Plain-language verdict built by deterministic rules from TrendStats. Never by an LLM.

correlation.title: Correlation
correlation.description: Pearson r between the witnesses over the common period

variable_id.title: Variable Id
variable_id.description: Any variable that has a witness_group; its whole group is compared

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: e.g. 'Water vapour in the air column'

WitnessesResult.title: WitnessesResult
WitnessesResult.description: Block D. The same quantity seen by independent sources over their common period.
